pages.text: The clasp opens more easily now. There is a clean space beneath it, the shape of a thumb.
pages.title: Blood assay
What the paper drinks
pages.text: Sneak-use this journal to take a blood sample. It costs one heart and is refused if that would kill you. Then open the guide normally; the field record at the end of this chapter shows the assay.

pages.title: What the paper drinks
pages.text: Exposure alone unlocks these notes. The assay itself still needs a sample.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: Live hearts can build infection while you stay nearby. The effects intensify by stage; extreme exposure has consequences beyond a passing sickness.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: Low exposure subsides away from the source. Check the blood record before another long harvest. A warding effect can reduce exposure, but it is no excuse to ignore a heart.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: The book remembers its sample. A fresh book must drink for itself.
